sql.query: SELECT CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='TEAM_CHAT' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=:tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AS UNSIGNED) hasAccess,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_chat_participants cp INNER JOIN tbl_chat_conversations c ON c.id=cp.conversationId AND c.tenantId=cp.tenantId AND c.conversationType='direct' AND c.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_chat_messages msg ON msg.conversationId=c.id AND msg.tenantId=c.tenantId AND msg.isDeleted=0 WHERE cp.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND cp.userId=:userId AND cp.isActive=1 AND msg.senderUserId<>:userId2 AND msg.id>COALESCE(cp.lastReadMessageId,0)) unreadCount,COALESCE((SELECT ut.chatAvailability FROM tbl_user_tenants ut WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId3 AND ut.userId=:userId3 AND ut.isActive=1 LIMIT 1),'available') chatAvailability,(SELECT ut.chatStatusMessage FROM tbl_user_tenants ut WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId4 AND ut.userId=:userId4 AND ut.isActive=1 LIMIT 1) chatStatusMessage
